docs.description: Tab labels, as a JSON array.
Index of the selected tab (past the last tab means the last one). A new index from the server wins; a removed attribute is ignored.
Server-confirmed value: :state(pending) while the local selection differs from the server's selected attribute (see revert()).
Name reported in sb-change (e.g. the field of a command).

slots.name: <label-slug>
slots.description: Panel content per tab: slot="docs" for a tab labelled "Docs", slot="übersicht" for "Übersicht". A slot name an earlier tab already has gets the tab's index appended ("c-1" for a second tab whose label gives "c").

events.name: input
events.description: The user moved the selection (a click or an arrow key); host.selected is the new index.

events.name: change
events.description: The selection is committed: at once for a click, after a short pause for the keyboard.

events.name: sb-change
events.description: Same moment. detail: { name, value, label } (value is the index): ready for a command.
